story:
Logline: The Overlord counts the village's diamonds one at a time into a row that runs off the slab, and one place stays empty: someone has been keeping some.
Characters: Overlord: bored, enormous, wants the count right. Announcer: delighted, distant, wants a show. Imps: bow and go.
Turn: The sack turns out empty and one place in the row is a diamond short; he looks up the shaft at a pinpoint of daylight.
Payoff: The announcer cheers, he says 'Quiet.', cut to black.
Why it matters: Video5 after Level 21 (Floor 951), written in Docs/LoreVideos.md; Hell's showmanship and repetition, no office jokes, slimes are villagers.
Who it's for: anyone, no game knowledge needed.
